before.requirement: Allow cJSON_Minify to reduce a whole-input single-line comment to an empty string.
before.reason: Minify consumes the comment and newline. The parser rejects the initial slash, so the harness returns before Minify.

after.requirement: Allow cJSON_Minify to reduce a whole-input single-line comment to an empty string.
after.reason: The same Minify behavior remains supported, and the same parse-success gate prevents the call.

claims.reason: The same whole-input comment behavior exists on both sides. The same old-harness parse gate blocks it on both sides; a parsed JSON prefix followed by a comment cannot produce an empty whole-input result.
